name: Our Daily Bread Food Pantry (Royse City Methodist Church)
hoursNotes: Additional free-produce distributions on the 1st Monday 5–7pm and 3rd Monday 1–3pm.

notes: Full-service drive-up pantry; North Texas Food Bank partner agency.
